text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early one morning on my way to the trainer's office,
I ran into Curren Bouquetd'or, who was holding a small parcel and murmuring softly to herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—all the moisture is completely dried out.
Now, all that's left is...
choice_data_list: Good morning, Bouquet. What are you up to?
Good morning, Bouquet. What are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—.
I was thinking of making potpourri... with dried flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's like a natural fragrance made from flowers—and it smells lovely.
Once I add a few drops of oil and put it in a jar, it'll be all done.
choice_data_list: Flower scents, huh? They're so soothing. I love them.
Flower scents, huh? They're so soothing. I love them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Have you visited the academy's garden plot yet?
Many flowers are in full bloom this time of year—they smell wonderful.
choice_data_list: Really? Now you've got me curious!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...If you'd like, would you care to come along right now?
I was just on my way to tend to the flowers myself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
This planter has jasmine.
It's right in full bloom—known for its sweet, captivating scent.
choice_data_list: You're right, it smells wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—it's a very calming fragrance, isn't it?
It's quite popular for aromatherapy and perfume, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Tulips are so vivid and eye-catching—
they're often used in floral arrangements.
choice_data_list: They're all so pretty... I could gaze at them forever.
They're all so pretty... I could gaze at them forever.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—.
Looking at flowers warms my heart, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe flowers have the power to soothe the soul.
Whether blooming in a field—or arranged in bouquets and potpourri.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If I can bring even a little brightness to everyone's hearts
through things like this—it would make me so happy.
choice_data_list: (Everyone's hearts, huh... That's so like Bouquet.)
(Everyone's hearts, huh... That's so like Bouquet.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...These flowers must be filled to the brim with her gentle kindness toward others.
Looking around once more—
choice_data_list: Oh... is this a fresh sprout?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside a sun-drenched planter,
a few tiny sprouts were peeking out from the soil.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Those are—dahlias.
The bulbs I planted a while back—just sprouted the other day.
choice_data_list: I see. I hope they bloom beautifully.
I see. I hope they bloom beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
They're a birthday present for my mother—so I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
They won't bloom until autumn, so it'll take some time—
but I'm sure they'll make a gorgeous bouquet.
choice_data_list: Autumn... Naturally, that's still quite a ways off.
Autumn... Naturally, that's still quite a ways off.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—but watching them grow day by day is such a joy.
Watering them, pulling weeds...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Besides—waiting is just preparing for the joy to come.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Sprouting, budding, blooming.
Raising flowers—is a continuous journey of waiting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However—because we care for them and wait patiently—
the joy when they finally bloom is all the greater.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And imagining the smile of the person receiving the flowers...
That's another part of the fun while waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through growing flowers, she's probably grown accustomed to waiting.
Even so, caring for them over such a long time must be hard work.
choice_data_list: If you'd like... want some help tending to the flowers?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: I'm a total novice, but I wondered if there's anything I could do.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—.
It's very kind of you to offer—thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However—I'm quite alright.
I love taking care of flowers, so just the thought alone—ah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you'd like—would you come visit here again?
I think the flowers would be... happier with someone to look at them.
choice_data_list: I see... Got it! I'll come by again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Pestering her any further would only get in her way.
After admiring the flowers a while longer, I returned to work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later... feeling a sudden urge to see the flowers,
I headed back to the garden plot. There—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The soil is—yes, not dry at all.
No need for water just yet—
choice_data_list: (Ah... it's Bouquet.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Dear dahlia...
I'm so happy to see you growing your sprouts so nicely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
May you bloom into a lovely flower.
Let's keep doing our best together from now on, okay?
choice_data_list: (...Just as I thought...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She waits for the flowers.
Devoting herself wholeheartedly, cradling a gentleness far greater than most.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why—as an amateur—
I felt I shouldn't needlessly meddle in her flower-raising.
choice_data_list: (I should just watch over her quietly.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without helping directly, there must be something I can do.
With that thought, I watched her from a distance as she gazed upon the flowers.
